clips.text_zh: 22歲做狗狗幣揸咗幾年沙灘，然後喺2021年23萬美金買咗condo，兩年後錢燒晒，要返學做返個打工仔。仲有學生債同卡數。睇完好有共鳴，condo唔係資產係鎖死人生。🙏 又係學費。
clips.text_en_b1: I got into Doge at 22 and made random crypto money. I quit school, bought a $230K condo, and lived two years with no job. When the money ran out I went back to school, graduated, and now make $100K at 27. I have student debt and credit card debt, and I feel stuck in a cycle of work, consume, repeat.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ condo regret thread from a former crypto kid
clips.text_en_b2: I got into Doge at 22 and rode the crypto wave for a few years before cashing out around $230K, which I immediately sank into a condo at 23. Two years of coasting burned through every cent, so I crawled back to school, graduated, and now grind a $100K salary at 27. Student loans and credit card debt are piled up, and I feel like the condo locked my whole life down.
clips.text_en_c1: At twenty-two, I stumbled into Dogecoin and accumulated a sizeable crypto nest egg, which led me to make what I now recognise as a financially catastrophic decision. With no employment, I dropped out of university and purchased a condominium for 230,000 dollars. For roughly two years I coasted on those savings, but once the funds evaporated I was forced to return to higher education, eventually graduating and securing a salaried position paying 100,000 dollars annually at twenty-seven. Despite this apparent recovery, I remain saddled with both student loans and lingering credit card obligations, perpetually locked into a cycle in which I merely work, consume, and repeat.
clips.text_en_c2: Having accumulated a modest fortune from early Dogecoin speculation at twenty-two, the original poster liquidated his crypto holdings to purchase a condominium at the ludicrous price of $230,000, convinced, as twenty-three-year-olds so often are, that the appreciation curve was inevitable. For two gilded years he lounged on tropical beaches, sustained by nothing but residual gains and the dopamine of a chart that only seemed to climb. When, predictably, the capital evaporated, he was compelled to re-enrol, complete his degree, and re-enter the labour market at twenty-seven, where he now draws a respectable $100,000 salary that is nonetheless consumed by student loans and revolving credit.

clips.text_zh: 個maid直接開晒價：BTC 2.5M / ETH 175K / SOL 5000 / DOGE 4.20。睇完好尷尬，呢啲number除咗令自己開心之外冇任何用途。考牌都未搞掂，睇人哋發夢都唔關我事lol。
clips.text_en_b1: Anon posted a price target list from a time-travelling crypto elf maid. BTC = 2,500,000. ETH = 175,000. XRP = 10,000. BNB = 7,500. SOL = 5,000. LINK = 5.54. DOGE = 4.20. ADA = 0.35. PEPE = 0.05. Pure copium numbers, but at least it puts the targets in one place.

signal.rationale: Implied long bias from the elf maid's mega target list

clips.text_en_b2: Anon posted an elaborate price target list allegedly handed down by a time-travelling crypto elf maid, and /biz/ is having a field day. BTC = 2,500,000. ETH = 175,000. XRP = 10,000. BNB = 7,500. SOL = 5,000. LINK = 5.54. DOGE = 4.20. ADA = 0.35. PEPE = 0.05. Every figure is pure copium, but at least it's all in one place.
clips.text_en_c1: A poster on the business board published what can only be described as a fantastical price-target compilation, ostensibly authored by some manner of clairvoyant crypto oracle masquerading as a maid character. The targets themselves are as follows: Bitcoin at 2,500,000, Ethereum at 175,000, XRP at 10,000, BNB at 7,500, Solana at 5,000, Chainlink at 5.54, Dogecoin at 4.20, Cardano at 0.35, and PEPE at 0.05. While these figures represent nothing more substantial than concentrated copium, there is a certain satisfaction in seeing every speculative aspiration consolidated within a single post.
clips.text_en_c2: An anonymous contributor has promulgated a comprehensive price-target manifesto allegedly sourced from a clairvoyant crypto oracle masquerading as a maid, a document whose numerology reveals far more about the author's psychological coping mechanisms than about any plausible market trajectory. The projections, dutifully enumerated, run as follows: Bitcoin at $2,500,000, Ethereum at $175,000, XRP at $10,000, BNB at $7,500, Solana at $5,000, Chainlink at $5.54, Dogecoin, with characteristic irreverence, at $4.20, Cardano languishing at $0.35, and PEPE rounding out the fever dream at $0.05. While these figures possess no empirical foundation whatsoever, their very absurdity serves a consolatory function, providing, as the poster notes, a single consolidated repository of optimism for those whose conviction has long since departed from rational inquiry.

clips.text_zh: g/今日嘅神科問題：你識做啲咩係最新嘅OpenAI AGI model做唔到你做唔好嘅嘢？睇完好灰，本身我做survey都驚比AI取代，仲有乜嘢係我做到AI做唔到。考牌真係唯一出路。
clips.text_en_b1: What can you do that the newest OpenAI AGI model can't do better? /g/ is asking anons today. Honestly the question hits hard for anyone in a mid-skill job. If the model can already write code, draft reports, and crunch numbers, what's left for the rest of us?
clips.source_hint: /g/ thread asking anons what they can still do better than AGI
clips.text_en_b2: /g/'s soul-crushing question of the day: what can you actually do that the newest OpenAI AGI model can't already do better? If the model can write code, draft reports, and crunch numbers more reliably than most mid-skill workers, what's left for the rest of us? Honestly the thread hits hard because very few people have a satisfying answer.
clips.text_en_c1: The technology board has posed what may well be the defining question of our era: what remains within the exclusive capability of human beings that the latest OpenAI AGI model cannot execute with greater competence? The query lands with particular force upon those of us occupying mid-skill positions, myself emphatically included. Should these systems already be capable of writing functional code, drafting coherent reports, and processing numerical datasets with superhuman accuracy, then one must seriously interrogate what residual economic value the average knowledge worker can possibly offer. If I cannot even guarantee professional licensure, one wonders whether conventional career pathways retain any meaningful viability whatsoever.
clips.text_en_c2: The technology board /g/ has, in its customary fashion, posed a deceptively simple question whose implications are quietly devastating: what remains within the exclusive province of human competence once the latest OpenAI model has demonstrated parity, or indeed superiority, across the entire spectrum of cognitively demanding tasks? The query, ostensibly a parlour game, lands with considerably more force than its breezy phrasing suggests, particularly upon those whose livelihoods depend upon intermediate analytical work. If the model can compose competent code, draft passable reports, and execute numerical analysis without complaint or compensation, then the residual justification for employing a middle manager, a junior consultant, or, indeed, an entire strata of white-collar functionaries begins to dissolve into obsolescence.

clips.text_zh: pol/ 今日最膠：Elon宣稱mRNA可以將人類變成蝴蝶。雖然係grooming poster，但X cancel個link幾好笑。又係AI生成嘅垃圾內容，睇完當睇戲。
clips.text_en_b1: WE CAN TURN HUMANS TO BUTTERFLIES WITH MRNA, ELON MUSK ANNOUNCED. A pol/ poster dropped an xcancel link to Vision4theBlind and asked anons if they would take the butterfly mRNA vaccine. Pure bait, but the screenshot is everywhere on X tonight.
clips.source_hint: /pol/ ironic mRNA butterfly bait with Musk fake announcement
clips.text_en_b2: /pol/'s top shitpost tonight: Elon allegedly announcing that mRNA tech can turn humans into butterflies. A poster dropped an xcancel link to Vision4theBlind and asked anons whether they'd take the butterfly mRNA vaccine, which is obviously pure bait. Even so, the screenshot has been spreading all over X, and people are losing their minds over what is clearly AI-generated garbage.
clips.text_en_c1: The politically-oriented board served up what can only be characterised as peak absurdity today, featuring a fabricated announcement attributed to Elon Musk declaring that mRNA technology could, in some unspecified fashion, transform human beings into butterflies. A user circulated an xcancel link to the account Vision4theBlind and solicited opinions regarding whether respondents would consent to receiving the so-called butterfly mRNA vaccine. While the poster clearly constitutes yet another instance of AI-generated garbage content that has proliferated across the platform, the screenshot has nevertheless propagated extensively throughout X this evening, proving once again that absurdity travels faster than reason.
clips.text_en_c2: The political board has, as it periodically does, seized upon an absurdity with the zeal of a cat discovering a particularly luminous string. Elon Musk, or rather an xcancel-archived account bearing his name and aesthetic, has announced, with all the gravitas that a Vision4theBlind screenshot can muster, that mRNA technology now possesses the capability to metamorphose human beings into butterflies, an evolutionary leap forward that, one presumes, has been a longstanding priority for civilised society. The accompanying poll, a masterwork of engagement optimisation, inquires whether respondents would consent to inoculation with this putative lepidopteran serum, an option that, if selected, presumably initiates an irreversible chrysalis. The poster has gleefully distributed the link with the candour of someone who understands perfectly that virality and sincerity are, on this particular platform, antithetical concepts.

clips.text_zh: v/ 有人洩露咗一份development budget文件，講緊個遊戲做咗305M美金開發成本，未計marketing。305M美金喺香港買condo可以買幾多層。S15睇到悶，不如睇下呢啲幕後數字。
clips.text_en_b1: A leaked document says this game had a $305 million development budget, not counting marketing. /v/ is asking how a studio spends that much before launch. For context, that's more than a lot of AAA movies and triple the usual big-budget game, and fans are not happy.
clips.source_hint: /v/ thread on leaked $305M game development budget
clips.text_en_b2: A leaked development document claims this game swallowed a $305 million budget before launch, and that figure doesn't even include marketing spend. To put it in perspective, that's more than plenty of AAA blockbusters and roughly triple the typical big-budget game. /v/ is baffled about how a studio burns through that kind of cash, and unsurprisingly, fans are not happy.
clips.text_en_c1: A leaked internal document surfacing on the videogames board reveals that the production costs of a particular title reached a staggering 305 million dollars prior to launch, exclusive of any marketing expenditure whatsoever. Anons are now grappling with the fundamental question of how a development studio could conceivably allocate such an extraordinary sum across a single project. To contextualise this figure, it exceeds the budgets of numerous AAA cinematic productions and represents approximately triple the expenditure one would typically associate with even the most ambitious mainstream releases.
clips.text_en_c2: An internal production document, evidently liberated from the studio's corporate sphincter by an employee possessed of both conscience and poor operational security, has revealed a figure that has occasioned considerable dismay within the enthusiast community: a development budget of $305,000,000, a sum that excludes marketing expenditure entirely and thereby represents only the foundational cost of bringing the title to its current state. To contextualise, this sum substantially exceeds the production budgets of most prestige cinematic releases and dwarfs by a factor of three the typical outlay for a marquee gaming title, which renders the eventual retail proposition, whatever its merits, a particularly audacious commercial undertaking.

clips.text_zh: fit/ 有個post講佢同identical twin兄統一樣食一樣嘢，連大便calories都一樣燒過驗過，但佢肥佢兄瘦。連雙胞胎都搞唔清CICO，我仲洗乜計macro。肥仔信今日又叫我gym，但我只想瞓覺。
clips.text_en_b1: Anon and his identical twin brother measured everything: same calories, same macros, even their poop was burned in a lab and the calorie count matched. Yet one brother is lean and the other is obese. /fit/ is melting down because the CICO dogma can't explain it.
clips.text_en_b2: An anon on /fit/ measured absolutely everything with his identical twin brother: identical calories, identical macros, and both had their poop burned in a lab to confirm matching outputs. Despite the controlled setup, one brother is lean while the other is clearly obese. The thread is melting down because if identical twins can break the CICO model, the entire dogma falls apart.
clips.text_en_c1: A poster on the fitness board describes a genuinely fascinating experiment conducted alongside his identical twin brother, wherein both individuals consumed identical caloric intakes with precisely matched macronutrient distributions. Furthermore, laboratory analysis was performed on faecal samples from each subject, with caloric content verified and confirmed equivalent. Despite these rigorously controlled conditions, one brother has maintained a lean physique whilst the other has remained decidedly obese. The thread has descended into spirited debate, as this outcome fundamentally undermines the CICO doctrine upon which much contemporary nutritional advice rests.
clips.text_en_c2: An anonymous poster and his monozygotic twin have, in a fit of scientific rigour that borders on the pathological, subjected the calories-in-calories-out doctrine to a controlled empirical examination whose methodology is, regrettably, more exacting than anything published in the recent obesity literature. For a sustained period, the brothers consumed identical macronutrient profiles, after which samples of their respective excreta were incinerated in a laboratory calorimeter, with the resultant thermal measurements confirming caloric parity. Despite this meticulous equivalence of intake and outflow, one sibling presents as lean while the other is clinically obese, a result that has prompted the fitness community to undergo something approaching an ontological crisis.

clips.text_zh: a/ 今日Soremachi作者Ishiguro上咗條片，自己rank最鍾意嘅角色，畫咗啲泳裝版，仲講咗Ebi-chan原型係佢小學暗戀嘅女仔。睇完好治癒，不過我冇女仔可以暗戀，單身三十年lol。
clips.text_en_b1: Soremachi & Friends dropped a new YouTube video where mangaka Ishiguro ranks his favourite characters from his own manga and draws them in swimsuits. He also shares random stuff, like the fact that Ebi-chan is based on his first crush from elementary school.
clips.text_en_b2: Soremachi & Friends just dropped a new YouTube video where mangaka Ishiguro ranks his favourite characters from his own series and sketches them in swimsuits, which fans are absolutely eating up. He also drops random trivia, including the charming reveal that Ebi-chan was based on his first crush back in elementary school. It's wholesome content, even though some anons are feeling the sting of being forever single.
clips.text_en_c1: The anime board celebrated the appearance of a new YouTube upload from mangaka Ishiguro, the creator of Soremachi and Friends, in which he ranks his personal favourite characters from his own series and produces fresh swimsuit illustrations of each. The video contained additional tangential revelations, most notably the disclosure that the character Ebi-chan was directly inspired by his first childhood crush during elementary school. The content proved thoroughly heartwarming to longtime fans of the work, though for those of us who have endured three decades without a romantic partner, such nostalgic anecdotes inspire only wistful contemplation rather than genuine emotional uplift.
clips.text_en_c2: The manga artist Ishiguro, whose Soremachi serial has cultivated a devoted following among readers who appreciate quiet observation and the gentle absurdities of adolescence, has surfaced on YouTube with a video that oscillates between the confessional and the celebratory, ranking his own creations with the proprietary authority of a father selecting favourites among his children, however reluctantly. In addition to enumerating his preferences, he has rendered several of the principal cast in swimwear illustrations that are certain to occasion predictable enthusiasm within the commentariat. More revealingly, he has disclosed that the character Ebi-chan, presumably a personification of youthful infatuation, is modelled upon a primary school classmate who, by his own admission, became the object of his earliest romantic fixation.
